subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about pulling browsers back to a paid order for {Brand} on retargeting. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed order itself, read back through an S2S postback via your MMP, and we hold each order through your cancellation window so a refunded or cancelled basket reverses before it is billed. That is what keeps the line counting net kept orders, around 7,000 a day on this supply (illustrative). If it helps, I can pull the cuisine-segment read for your audiences. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-order + cancellation-window proof
illustrative_flags: around 7,000 retargeted completed orders a day on this supply (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN food_and_delivery: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof from parent (completed-order optimization + S2S postback + cancellation-window net-kept-orders); one illustrative MobUpps figure (~7,000 orders/day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; native English register; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
